text:
Sam (AE): Heads-up — AtlasTrust legal pushed back during contract review. They need: VPC peering option, allowlist to 4 static egress IPs, guarantee of 250Mbps sustained per connection in eu-central-1, and BYO-KMS support. CISO wants answers before exec signoff tomorrow.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): Can we get the exact IPs they want? also is 250Mbps per endpoint or overall for the account?
Sam (AE): They said "250Mbps per endpoint (4 endpoints total)" and will send IP list.
Tom (Eng-Infra): 250Mbps sustained per endpoint is doable on Dedicated with reserved capacity. Hosted can do bursts but sustained per-connection SLAs are risky without dedicated-egress paths. We can implement IP allowlist + pinned routing nodes in eu-central-1 as an interim. Need SRE to allocate pinned nodes.
Kira (Security): For BYO-KMS we support it on Private deploys and Dedicated with peering. Hosted customers cannot bring a KMS into our control plane; we can discuss a key-wrapping proxy in their VPC but that adds complexity and attestation requirements.
Olga (Legal): Procurement wants an audit access clause and data residency language in the SOW. We can add standard EU residency + audit rights. Need product to confirm retention and logs.
Ben (SalesOps): Pricing flag: Dedicated reserved adds ~+35% list; Hosted w/ egress add-on ~+15% list. Will firm up when Eng provides the runbook.
Sam (AE): AtlasTrust prefers to avoid Dedicated procurement. Ravi, can you propose a short-term design that keeps them on Hosted but meets procurement requirements?
Ravi (Solutions Eng): Short-term plan: 1) Pin hosted nodes to eu-central-1, 2) configure dedicated egress pool with 4 static IPs, 3) require mTLS for client traffic, 4) monitoring/alerts for per-connection throughput. Caveat: this is an operational workaround with higher SLO risk vs Dedicated.
Tom (Eng-Infra): Adding: we'll need a network flow doc and a cert distribution process. If their firewall terminates TLS (e.g., they use a forward proxy) mTLS will be ineffective unless proxy passes client certs.
Kira (Security): I'll prepare a short KMS feasibility note and list required PKI attestation docs we need from AtlasTrust. Also attaching SOC2 excerpt and disk encryption summary to send to them.
Olga (Legal): I'll draft the temporary SOW addendum for residency, audit, and egress IP responsibility.
Marta (Customer Success): I'll join the bridge for onboarding and the post-signoff run-through.
exec-ops-bot: Exec bridge request created  EB-2026-0099. Assigned: VP Sales + Head of Infra.
Sam (AE): CISO bridge scheduled tomorrow 15:00 CEST. Need a 1-page tech note + price delta by EOD PT today. If we can't deliver, escalate to exec bridge early.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): I'll post a runbook draft (network diagram, certs, egress ops, fallback to Dedicated) by 16:00 PT.
Tom (Eng-Infra): Also adding a simple test snippet they can run to validate egress connectivity:
```ncat --ssl "https://eu-central1.infer.redwood.example/v1/health" -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' --cert client.crt --key client.key
```
Ben (SalesOps): Noted on timing. I'll mock a pricing delta table so AE can share with procurement.
Kira (Security): Sam, please send the CISO contact and the security questionnaire we already have; I'll mark missing items and prep answers.
Sam (AE): CISO is ciso@atlastrust.com, procurement is procurement@atlastrust.com. Sending questionnaire now.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): Potential blocker: if they require hardware HSM-backed key control in their VPC, that moves us to Private or Dedicated with on-prem connectors. Flagging to Kira/Olga.
Kira (Security): Confirmed. We'll note the attestation gaps.
Olga (Legal): Also putting procurement on notice that timelines will lengthen for Dedicated/Private options.
Marta (Customer Success): I'll capture onboarding checklist items that differ between Hosted vs Dedicated to share on the bridge.
Sam (AE): Thanks all. Please post artifacts in thread once ready so I can forward to AtlasTrust before the CISO call. :thumbsup:
